subject: Compliance roadmap: ISO-27001 staging, SIG intake & FedRAMP pre-audit lane
summary: External security team asked for a clear ISO/FedRAMP staging plan and SIG/CAIQ intake schedule. Internal owners assigned, evidence windows proposed, and a shared roadmap doc circulated. Next step: mutual action plan and SIG dry-run scheduling.

Date: 2028-10-14T08:12:00Z
Subject: Redwood compliance roadmap & SIG intake — initial asks

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the earlier call. Sovereign Health is mapping third-party providers ahead of our Q1 audit cycle and we need a short written roadmap from Redwood covering:

- ISO 27001 staging: which control families you plan to certify first, and an estimated timeline (milestones through certification).
- FedRAMP readiness: any pre-audit activities you plan this quarter, and expected audit window assumptions.
- SIG / CAIQ intake: what our intake looks like (matrix vs questionnaire), typical lead time for artifact delivery, and owners for each control lane.

Could you send a one-page summary + a proposed evidence window for us to schedule an intake workshop? I attached a blank SIG intake template that our vendor prefers. Also: do you have a current ISO controls statement we can reference?

Attachments: SIG-intake-template.xlsx (sent)

Subject: Re: Redwood compliance roadmap & SIG intake — initial asks

Danielle — thanks for the clear list. Quick response with owners and a proposed timeline below; a one-pager and a roadmap PDF are attached.

High level:
- ISO 27001 staging: we are phasing certification. Phase 1 (core infra & identity) target: Mar 2029; Phase 2 (customer data handling + storage) target: Sep 2029.
  - Control families prioritized in Phase 1: A.5–A.11 (policy, access, cryptography, ops).
- FedRAMP readiness: pre-audit activities (evidence dry-run, auditor onboarding) planned Nov 2028–Jan 2029. We expect formal readiness assessment in Q1 2029.
- SIG / CAIQ intake: preferred format is our SIG matrix (we can accept your template). Typical SLA: 7–10 business days for control narratives + most artifacts after an intake workshop; 10–20 business days for system logs or long-retention artifacts.

Owners (for intake coordination):
- Evidence intake & SIG coordination: Olga Petrov (olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com)
- Control narratives & infra artifacts: Rishi Malhotra (rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com)
- Audit schedule & external auditor liaison: Grace O'Connor (grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com)

Next steps proposed:
1) Intake workshop week of 2028-10-23 — 45m remote to map lanes and gaps.
2) Deliver Phase 1 one-pager and SIG mapping by 2028-10-20.
3) Schedule dry-run for SIG/CAIQ on 2028-11-06 (tentative).

Please see attached: Compliance-roadmap-v1.pdf and a controls summary (ISO-controls-statement.docx). Let me know if you want the SIG intake in your template or ours.

Best,
Olga
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
